issue.title: Implement Upload and Deletion of All Takes
issue.body:
Mobile lets each user record up to 5 takes per passage (#71) and view takes from every account on the device (#279). No ticket defines which of those takes reach the server or what happens on the server when a take is deleted on the device. This ticket closes that gap so the server holds the same set of takes as the device.

## Functional Requirements

### Take Upload
- Upload every take recorded for a passage, whether or not it is the selected take.
- Upload takes from every account on the device when that account syncs.
- Upload a take recorded offline on the next sync, using the existing sync rules.

### Take Deletion
- When a user deletes a take on the device, delete that take from the server on the next sync.
- Delete the take from the server whether it is the selected take or not.
- When the selected take is deleted, keep the existing behavior from #71 that automatically selects the next available take, and sync that new selection.
- Do not send a delete to the server for a take that was deleted before it ever uploaded.
- Keep the delete pending and retry on the next sync if the sync fails.
- Clear the pending delete once the server confirms it.

### Take Cap
- Enforce the 5-take cap per user on the device only.
- Upload all takes on the device even when the total across accounts exceeds 5 for a passage.
- Do not send the cap to the server or reject takes on the server because of it.

Note: Do not change when sync runs or how it is triggered; this ticket only changes which takes and deletions the existing sync sends.

Note 2: Syncing a changed selection follows #701.
